audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer described a flat 'even' lane at every stage while the content layer and the packet both describe a lane that swings: Orianna owns 1-3, it goes even at 4-5, and Katarina owns 6 through first item.
audit.why: Kit-grounded: Katarina is melee and Bouncing Blade only reaches 625 against your 815, so the first three levels are free for you. Shunpo at 12s and 725 range, then Death Lotus at 75s, is what buys her the middle of the game back.
audit.corrected: phases[].side moved to match the content chart, with each why rewritten to argue the side it now names.
sources: champ-data/_kits/katarina.json (Q range 625, E range 725/cd 12/11/10/9/8, R cd 75/60/45)

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes said 'level 6 doubles your lane presence' in a matchup where the content layer, the packet chart and the win rate all say level 6 belongs to Katarina. It also claimed 'a third of a health bar' with no source.
audit.why: Her level 6 is a 75s ultimate plus the Voracity reset chain; yours is a 110s ultimate she can Zhonya's. Calling 6 your spike inverts the matchup.
audit.corrected: Spikes now read: Lost Chapter steadies mana, 6 is her window, two items and grouping take it back.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most useful interaction in the matchup was never stated: Death Lotus is a channel and Command: Shockwave's displacement ends it. The page only said 'the ult answers fights, not waves'.
audit.why: Riot's own text plus the kit's channel flag make it explicit. Also unstated: Shunpo blinks to her own daggers, not only to you, which is why ball-on-self has to be up before she picks one up; and Voracity dramatically reduces her cooldowns when a champion she damaged dies, which is why one kill snowballs the lane.
audit.corrected: Channel interrupt, dagger-targeting and Voracity now appear in cooldowns, tldr, winCon, late, carry and report[5].
sources: champ-data/_kits/katarina.json (R channel flag + text, E text, P text)
